breathingRoomComparison.wording: Breathing Room, which we build, is a macOS 13+ Apache-2.0 maintenance preview with free local storage/process views and optional hosted AI Care advertised at $5 USD/month or $50 USD/year.
requiredCaveats: 0.1.0-preview.1 release is not Developer ID signed or notarized; clean-machine and physical Intel behavior unverified.
Python 3.10+ required for inventory/legacy scripts; permissions limit coverage.
Hosted assistant requires authentication/internet and can send relevant paths/process/storage data; not entirely offline AI.
Daily care needs app running and exact saved approvals; optional automatic Ruff cache mode is a separate bounded exception to default review.
No full duplicate finder, recovery, media conversion or antivirus parity established; never assert unsupported absence or equivalence.

workflow.title: MacOptimizers diagnostics or storage cleanup? Choose the right next step
workflow.intent: Help a Mac owner distinguish a full-disk investigation from a specific Wi-Fi, audio, Finder or Spotlight troubleshooting need before choosing a maintenance action.
workflow.description: Separate a storage problem from a subsystem fault before choosing cleanup or guided diagnostics. This is a source-based workflow, not a repair success test.
outline: Define the symptom and record OS/version without changing settings
Storage shortage: inspect categories and ownership; size is not deletion permission
Subsystem fault: explain vendor-documented shell-test/retest diagnostics and Premium boundary
Before any mutation: back up, inspect selected paths and risk level; avoid aggressive command recipes
Decision point: local storage/process investigation versus documented guided diagnostics; disclose Breathing Room affiliation and preview limitations
workflow.interactionPass: A local, non-scanning symptom checklist: storage shortfall / specific subsystem fault / both / uncertain. Show inspection-first routes, backups and escalation without prescribing shell repairs. Research handoff only; implementation belongs to draft stage.
workflow.visualPlan: Official linked diagnostics visual near lead only if rights resolved; labeled Breathing Room Space preview later. Link-only is insufficient for publication image gate.
workflow.differentiation: Not another generic cleaner ranking: focuses on diagnostic escalation versus explaining storage ownership.

comparison.title: Breathing Room vs MacOptimizers: storage investigation or guided diagnostics
comparison.intent: Concise tool-selection matrix, not a duplicate alternatives doorway.
rows: Free scope and paid model with EUR/USD distinguished
Local processing and online activation/hosted boundaries
Default approval versus documented risk-labelled diagnostics
Unknown helper grouping, recurring monitoring and developer adapter parity
comparison.conclusion: MacOptimizers merits consideration for vendor-documented guided diagnostics and a broad one-payment utility bundle. Breathing Room merits consideration for source-documented storage-owner/process investigation if the reader accepts preview and hosted-assistance caveats. No hands-on winner or speed/safety claim.

advantagesAndTradeoffs: MacOptimizers advertises a broad free base including duplicates and uninstallation, with a one-Mac lifetime Premium offer rather than monthly billing; scope and activation restrictions still matter.
Guided subsystem diagnostics, media processing and recovery are documented MacOptimizers options, not established Breathing Room equivalents; no efficacy tests were run.
Breathing Room's source documents storage ownership views, helper grouping, developer cache discovery and activity history, but those are not proof that MacOptimizers lacks corresponding functions.

Breathing Room is an explicitly limited preview; do not imply it is the safer or production-ready alternative. Its optional AI Care is hosted and recurring-priced, unlike the competitor's advertised lifetime licence.
